payload.title: Brand-neutral acceptance test
payload.description:
TI must run on the standard layout with no site hooks and without changing Machines on Machines' code. This is the proof that the layout is not MoM-shaped.
Scenario: The shared suite passes for a second brand
  Given TI with only a brand pack, sections and pages
  When the shared Gherkin suite and golden renders run
  Then they pass, and git shows no change in the Machines-on-Machines repository

Depends on: PPY-cf7e6e, PPY-88a883, PPY-613a29.
